policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Bangladesh visa on arrival
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry says its citizens may obtain a Bangladesh visa on arrival at certain crossings and airports.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The route is limited to certain border crossings and airports; exact port eligibility, documentation, fees and final admission must be confirmed before travel.
The separately linked online application does not change the arrival-issuance classification.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Dominican Republic visa-free entry
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry says its citizens do not need a visa for the Dominican Republic.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The mandatory electronic entry-and-exit form is not a visa or travel authorization.
The cited guidance directs travellers staying longer than 30 days to separate immigration information.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Eswatini visa-free entry
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry states that its citizens may enter Eswatini for up to 30 days without first obtaining a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to 30 days.
Passport validity, purpose, supporting documents and final border admission remain separate requirements.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Grenada visa on arrival
policies.summary: Grenada's official visa schedule maps Montenegro to Port of Entry, which the schedule defines as a visa granted on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Port of Entry as a visa granted on arrival; travellers should confirm any pre-clearance, document and fee requirements before departure.
Final admission remains discretionary.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Gambia advance visa
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry requires its citizens to possess a visa and identifies the Gambian Embassy in Brussels as the issuing post.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The cited guidance identifies consular issuance through the Gambian Embassy in Brussels; it does not establish an electronic or arrival-issued visa.
Application approval, documentation and final admission remain separate requirements.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Mauritius visa on arrival
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry says its citizens receive a visa upon arrival at Mauritius's international airport.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor through Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport.
The guidance requires a passport valid for the stay, return ticket, accommodation, funds of USD 100 per day and a pre-departure online form.
It states that Montenegrin citizens are exempt from the visa fee; final admission remains separate.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: North Macedonia visa-free entry
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry states that its nationals may enter North Macedonia visa-free for up to 90 days using a valid travel document.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to 90 days.
A separate identity-card route exists but is not needed to establish the ordinary-passport baseline.
Purpose, duration calculations and final admission remain separate requirements.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago visa-free entry
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry states that its nationals may visit Trinidad and Tobago visa-free for up to 30 days.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to 30 days with a valid travel document.
Purpose, supporting documents and final admission remain separate requirements.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Tunisia visa-free entry
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry says its citizens may enter and stay in Tunisia without first obtaining a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The page does not state a maximum stay; duration, purpose, supporting documents and final admission must be confirmed before travel.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Zambia visa-free entry
policies.summary: Montenegro's Foreign Ministry says its citizens may enter Zambia without first obtaining a visa for stays up to 90 days.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Montenegrin passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to 90 days.
Purpose, cumulative-stay calculation, supporting documents and final admission remain separate requirements.
